description: This PHP test class verifies the behavior of the getApiPermissions method of the DataGroupDao class within the OrangeHRM project. Specifically, it tests permission retrieval for different user groups (ESS, Admin) for the JobTitleAPI endpoint.

classes.name: DataGroupDaoGetApiPermissionsTest
classes.description: A test class extending TestCase, designed to test the getApiPermissions method in the DataGroupDao class, focusing on different user group permissions for the JobTitleAPI.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by setting the fixture file path, populating test data, and instantiating the DataGroupDao object.

methods.name: testGetApiPermissionsForEss
methods.description: Tests API permissions retrieval for the 'ESS' user group, asserting that only read permission is granted.

methods.name: testGetApiPermissionsForEssAndAdmin
methods.description: Tests API permissions for both 'ESS' and 'Admin' groups, checking read and create permissions for the first permission object and default false for other capabilities.
